Senses.Explanation: Xu Six carrying a board is the stock picture of one-sided vision: the board blocks one side while its bearer sees only the other. Named commentators apply the verdict to paired answers, lineage figures, and students trapped by either sound-and-form or purity. It is a criticism of partial seeing, not a biography of Xu Six.
